}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:33.400
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:34.400
    | text      = And you were like, God chose me as a child to lead the resistance against the devil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:39.599
    | text      = Your trainer might be like, hey man, what the fuck are you talking about?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:44.440
    | text      = We got three sets in of leg presses the other day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:47.559
    | text      = You also didn't fall to your knees and get healed by Jesus.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:51.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:52.119
    | text      = Come on, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:53.119
    | text      = I've seen you sweat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.119
    | text      = I wonder if there was a conversation between Alex and God at some point where God was like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.519
    | text      = listen, let me get out in front of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:00.599
    | text      = You're going to have to lie to people about me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.119
    | text      = You know you're not going to be able to sell my brand on other people's shows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:07.000
    | text      = So I give you full permission to omit me from your list of accomplishments, even though,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:12.599
    | text      = yes, I am God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:13.599
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:14.599
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:15.599
    | text      = He's like, I'm not going to take it personally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:16.599
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:17.599
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:18.599
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:19.599
    | text      = I'm God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:20.599
    | text      = I already planned this whole thing out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:21.599
    | text      = I can't be mad at you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:22.599
    | text      = I have to let you know in advance, it's cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:23.599
    | text      = It is cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:24.599
    | text      = It has to be cool because he doesn't seem to feel any guilt about it whatsoever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:27.359
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:28.359
    | text      = And it seems very different than what he says in a lot of other circumstances.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:31.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:32.680
    | text      = Weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:33.680
    | text      = Also a small point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:35.119
    | text      = There's no way Alex had Larry McDonald on his show because that dude died in 1983.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:40.279
    | text      = McDonald was on a Korean Airlines flight to South Korea that was shot down when it entered
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:44.960
    | text      = Soviet airspace.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:45.960
    | text      = And because he was a diehard anti-communist at John Birch Society guy, it became part
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:50.279
    | text      = of an elaborate conspiracy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:51.960
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:52.960
    | text      = Incidentally, Larry McDonald also ran his own intelligence company called Western Goals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:59.500
    | text      = An article about it in Politico quotes one of its former employees, Mary Jo Buckland,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:03.900
    | text      = as saying, quote, a lot of funding came from Germany, more than what came from the United
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:08.940
    | text      = States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:11.140
    | text      = A lot of it was kept from us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:13.259
    | text      = The Germans were all a lot of medals and they had a lot of money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:16.980
    | text      = The Germany people never came to the United States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:19.759
    | text      = They would fly Western Goals accountant to Germany.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:23.059
    | text      = Something didn't feel on the up and up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:26.220
    | text      = Western Goals, former John Birch Society guy, Germany.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:31.380
    | text      = I'm not liking it, buddy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:33.259
    | text      = That triangle doesn't hunt.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:35.339
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:36.339
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:37.339
    | text      = So that's the people that Alex looks up to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:38.339
    | text      = That's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:39.339
    | text      = Good stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:40.339
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:41.339
    | text      = Not God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:42.339
    | text      = I would say 95% racists explicit and extreme.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:45.779
    | text      = 5% crypto racists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:48.059
    | text      = Still 0% God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:49.579
    | text      = Crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:50.579
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:51.579
    | text      = So a lot of this is obviously, but Sean's not much of a spark of life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:59.740
    | text      = Not super entertaining.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:00.740
    | text      = I think Alex can feel it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:01.940
    | text      = And so he's got to fill space.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:03.819
    | text      = And a lot of this is just giving him a platform to complain about the Sandy Hook stuff because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:08.500
    | text      = the appeal to the Supreme Court just got rejected.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:12.140
    | text      = I can't imagine they thought that you would still be standing strong after this amount
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:17.900
    | text      = of time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:18.900
    | text      = I'm stronger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:19.900
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:21.220
    | text      = I mean, I love the Connecticut when he goes, you don't get about the Godfather, the movie,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:25.299
    | text      = the mafia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:26.299
    | text      = Oh yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:27.299
    | text      = Mario Puzo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:28.299
    | text      = I'm like, that's a great story about...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:31.660
    | text      = He was gonna go speak at a college, Mario Puzo, who'd never written anything, never
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:35.259
    | text      = done anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:36.259
    | text      = And he'd just hung around as Italian in New York and actually knew all the real mobs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:38.579
    | text      = So he put a fiction thing out on Backstreet with real people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:40.819
    | text      = He just changed the names.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:41.819
    | text      = It's actually a documentary, literally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:44.660
    | text      = And he writes it and he's gonna go speak at a top college on screenwriting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:48.339
    | text      = Top college.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:49.339
    | text      = Not one of those lower colleges.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:50.779
    | text      = You can pull this up, the story's in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.740
    | text      = And they say to him, they say...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:57.140
    | text      = So they want him to go address the whole class of writers and film students on how to screenwrite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:03.500
    | text      = So he goes to the bookstore to buy the best selling book on screenwriting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:07.539
    | text      = And the whole thing's about the Godfather script and Mario Puzo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:11.420
    | text      = He didn't know that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:12.619
    | text      = But the funny thing is, you know what the Godfather is, Sonny?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:15.259
    | text      = And I'm like, yeah, I'm like, yeah, the Mario Puzo book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:18.380
    | text      = He goes, no, no, the movie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:20.380
    | text      = You know, the Godfather, the mafia, you know what that is?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:22.579
    | text      = And I'm like, oh, do I know what it is?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:24.779
    | text      = You know what the real mafia is, jackass?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:26.900
    | text      = Anyways, and so called good people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:30.140
    | text      = You mess with long enough, you find out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:32.500
    | text      = But the point was, he's like, well, that's who we are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:34.299
    | text      = You're gonna lose no matter what.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:35.299
    | text      = So I'm gonna talk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:36.299
    | text      = But the point was, he's like, yeah, kid, once you learn we're thugs, once you learn we're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:40.339
    | text      = crooks, you're gonna go piss on yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:42.579
    | text      = No, it's why I'm waging war on you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:44.980
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:46.220
    | text      = Hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:47.220
    | text      = The idea of these people play these fucking games.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:49.859
    | text      = I'm coming for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:51.480
    | text      = You're not coming for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:52.480
    | text      = Are you though?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:53.480
    | text      = You understand that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:54.940
    | text      = I'm not locked in here with you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:56.480
    | text      = You're locked in here with me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:57.859
    | text      = Hey, five points.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:59.339
    | text      = I turned against you and you're on the wrong side of history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:02.779
    | text      = Whoo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:03.779
    | text      = I know it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:04.779
    | text      = You should have saved that for the end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:06.420
    | text      = That would have been the end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:07.420
    | text      = We still got so much farther to go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:09.940
    | text      = Here's the thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:10.940
    | text      = I haven't talked about this as much as I should.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:12.420
    | text      = It's just built to a head now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:13.660
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:14.660
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:16.339
    | text      = I feel great about it because, you know, oh, God, you get a website, you shut down our
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:20.460
    | text      = building.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:21.460
    | text      = Ooh, well, you just go work for other people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:23.220
    | text      = Already got my crew, new management, new everybody.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:26.140
    | text      = And then I've just got a job there that they chase me around that I don't give a shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:30.220
    | text      = I'm not a high roller.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:31.220
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.220
    | text      = So, I mean, what are you gonna do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:34.380
    | text      = So this is fun, but Alex doesn't realize what his actual appeal is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:38.740
    | text      = If he has to sell Infowars and go work for somebody else, it pierces the entire premise
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:42.940
    | text      = that his career is based on, which is that he's totally free.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:46.859
    | text      = He's his own man and no one can tell him what to do because he runs the whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:51.339
    | text      = If he closes up shop and goes to work for Bigley, then he can get fired.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:55.940
    | text      = Bigley obviously supports the political ideology that he pushes, but they're first and foremost
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:00.900
    | text      = a money-making operation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:03.140
    | text      = They sell shit, and if he does something that makes it impossible for them to make money
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:07.119
    | text      = selling shit, he's no longer worth employing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:10.940
    | text      = Alex can take on this posture that he doesn't need to be flashy and living a ritzy lifestyle,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:15.500
    | text      = and that's fair enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:17.140
    | text      = I do think that he would accept a certain amount of diminished luxury and continue doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:21.220
    | text      = what he's doing, but this isn't about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:24.099
    | text      = It's about his soul and being free.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:27.440
    | text      = At Infowars, Alex is free because it's a one-talent business built entirely around him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:33.140
    | text      = If he wants to get drunk and cry about demons on his show, no one can stop him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:37.599
    | text      = If he wants to pretend that an Ebola outbreak is about to happen in Denver, no one can stop him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:42.720
    | text      = If he wants to continue to harass the Sandy Hook plaintiffs and cover new stories in ways
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:47.539
    | text      = that mirror how he behaved to get those lawsuits started in the first place, no one can stop him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:53.559
    | text      = But Bigley isn't a one-talent business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:56.480
    | text      = They may like Alex and see a profit in him, but they run stores for tons of shitheads
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:01.880
    | text      = in the right-wing media and they don't need Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:05.220
    | text      = The audience may not immediately understand this, but the idea that Alex is an employee
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:10.140
    | text      = of someone else's thing will become a problem for them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:14.480
    | text      = In the back of their minds, the audience gets that in order for Alex to make money, he can't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:18.819
    | text      = own any business ever again, and that makes his position vulnerable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:23.700
    | text      = Bigley may be better than him going to work for Fox News, but ultimately it's not that different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:29.460
    | text      = He's giving up his independence and putting himself in a position where corporate interests
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:33.339
    | text      = can very easily exert pressure on his content or fire him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:38.500
    | text      = So all this talk about victory and all this bluster is fine, and I'm sure it feels good
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:42.339
    | text      = to do these rants and talk about Mario Puzo, but underneath this, Alex almost certainly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:47.700
    | text      = knows that it's not just a website or studio he's giving up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:51.579
